title: Brains, Minds and Machines
about: Marine Biological Laboratory three-week advanced research training course in Woods Hole, Massachusetts: Brains, Minds and Machines. The 2027 course runs Aug 08, 2027 - Aug 29, 2027; the application deadline is 29 March 2027.
requirements: Appropriate for graduate students, postdocs and faculty in computer science or neuroscience

upskill.name: AI Foundations
why: "Computer science and neuroscience (intelligence)" → AI Foundations Academy topics (machine learning, computing, intelligence); no single course objective covers the neuroscience side, so the Academy page is linked instead of a course

"graduate students, postdocs and faculty in computer science" → e.g. A001.03 objective "Transformer architecture (2017): self-attention; backbone of all modern LLMs and vision models" within the same Academy

card_alt: EduCut Connect card for Brains, Minds and Machines, a professional development course at the Marine Biological Laboratory (MBL) in Woods Hole, United States, with an application deadline of 29 Mar 2027. The photo is a general United States image showing the Statue of Liberty in front of the New York City skyline with the Empire State Building, not Woods Hole.
